list.title: Stock documents
list.description: Receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments and opening balances.

presets.saveBody: Stored under this name in this browser.
presets.name: Name

editor.description: Enter lines quickly from the keyboard; scan barcodes to add lines.
editor.deleteBody: The draft document is deleted permanently.
editor.readOnly: You may not edit this document.

lines.title: Lines
lines.serialsBody: Type or scan one serial number per line. Required: {{count}}.
lines.maxReached: A document can have at most {{max}} lines.
lines.fefo: Left empty, the lot expiring first (FEFO) is used.

scan.label: Scan barcode
scan.failed: The barcode could not be looked up.

validation.sameWarehouse: The target warehouse must differ from the source.
validation.maxLines: A document can have at most {{max}} lines.
validation.quantityPositive: The quantity must be greater than zero.
validation.lot: Lot-tracked items need a lot number.
validation.serialInteger: Serial-tracked items need a whole quantity.
validation.serialDuplicate: Serial number {{serial}} was entered more than once.

post.title: Post the document?
post.body: Stock movements are created and, where needed, a journal entry. A posted document cannot be changed, only reversed.

reverse.title: Reverse {{number}}?
reverse.body: Mirrored movements and a reversing journal entry are created; the document becomes cancelled.
reverse.reasonRequired: The reason must be at least 3 characters.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this document
conflict.body: Load the latest version before saving; your changes are not merged.

locked.title: The stock document is no longer a draft
locked.body: It was posted or cancelled meanwhile, so these changes cannot be saved. Load the latest version; your changes are not merged.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.refreshFailed: The latest data could not be loaded; what you see may be out of date.

count.listDescription: Start a count, enter counted quantities, review the variances and post.
count.startBody: Starting with a freeze turns the warehouse’s non-zero balances into count lines with their system quantity; the count is compared with them.
count.title: Count {{number}}
count.copySystem: Fill blanks with the system quantity
count.keys: Move between cells with the arrow keys and Enter; Ctrl+S saves.
count.uncountedWarning: {{count}} lines are not counted yet; uncounted lines are skipped when posting.
count.postBody: Count adjustment movements and a variance journal entry are created for the differences.
count.postNeedsCounts: Count at least one line before posting.
count.freeze: Freeze current stock (add the system quantities as lines)
count.scopeItemsHint: Leave empty to freeze every item in the warehouse.
count.addBody: For stock not on the list; its system quantity is the on-hand quantity when added. An existing item, location and lot updates that line.

import.title: Import a count CSV
import.body: Columns: item_code, counted_quantity and optional location_code, lot_no (comma or semicolon). Matching lines get the count, other rows are added. A dry run comes first; apply when there are no errors.
import.hasErrors: Fix the invalid rows and try the file again.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large (at most 5 MB).

reservation.title: Reservations
reservation.description: Stock held by sales and production documents; expired holds are dropped by a scheduled job.
reservation.releaseBody: The reserved {{quantity}} of {{item}} becomes available stock again.
reservation.createBody: Holds a quantity in a warehouse. Under a soft policy the part above the available stock is reported as a warning.
reservation.shortage: Reservation created; {{quantity}} exceeds the available stock.

reports.hubDescription: Stock status as of a date, stock ledger, valuation, ageing and other analyses.
reports.choose: Choose the parameters and run the report.
reports.basisBooked: Booked values ({{method}}): the amounts the stock account shows.
reports.basisSimulated: What-if values recomputed with {{method}}; they may differ from the books.
reports.basisLayers: Ages come from the FIFO cost layers.
reports.basisReceipts: Ages come from the newest receipts covering the stock.

stockStatus.title: Stock status as of
stockStatus.description: On-hand, reserved and available quantities with values on the chosen date.

stockLedger.title: Stock ledger (kardex)
stockLedger.description: Opening balance, movements and running quantity and value of an item.

valuation.title: Stock valuation
valuation.description: Quantity, average cost and stock value on a date.

ageing.title: Stock ageing
ageing.description: On-hand stock in age buckets by receipt date.

expiringLots.title: Expiring lots
expiringLots.description: Lots that expire within the given days (or have expired).

abc.title: ABC analysis
abc.description: A, B and C classes of the items by consumption value in the period (or stock value at its end).

turnover.title: Inventory turnover
turnover.description: Opening and closing stock value, consumption, average stock, turnover and days on hand.

reorder.title: Reorder suggestions
reorder.description: Items whose available quantity fell below the reorder point.

movementSummary.title: Movement summary
movementSummary.description: Opening, in, out and closing quantities and values in the period.
